programs.title: House Hunters
programs.sub_title: Large Home for Six Kids and Eight Pets
programs.desc: A recently married couple needs to find a home with enough space for their blended family of six kids and eight pets in New Palestine, Indiana. She wants something warm and homey, but he prefers a place with a more industrial look.

programs.title: House Hunters
programs.sub_title: Give Me History or Give Me Turnkey
programs.desc: A young couple struggles with deciding on their first home purchase near Washington, DC. She wants a traditional home and isn't afraid to go big on price or size, but he's the first in his family to own and wants to be careful with what they spend.

programs.title: Chateau DIY
programs.desc: Donna and Paul are on the high road to finishing their Scottish themed guest suite. Chris and Jolyon tackle an antique chandelier as they finish the grand salon. Its decision time for Jane and Rory as their hunt come to a close.

programs.title: Escape To The Chateau
programs.desc: With no guests to entertain, Dick and Angel get to work on the orangery with the help of a roofing expert and some pre-loved Welsh slate and discover some unexpected history beneath their feet.

programs.title: Renovation Nation
programs.desc: In Kent, Iain and Miranda get stuck into their attic bathroom wallpapering. Drew delves into his Cornish Regency villa's past. And Steve and Sally start work on their bathroom reno.

programs.title: Derelict Rescue
programs.desc: British builders take on the UK's most rundown, unusual buildings to create dream homes. From crumbling water towers to deserted churches and historic farmhouses, these families are risking everything for a new life in a unique home.

programs.title: House Hunters International
programs.sub_title: An Unexpected Family Move to Greater Melbourne
programs.desc: A job opportunity prompts a Wisconsin family to move sight unseen to Greater Melbourne, Australia. They're excited to explore an unfamiliar continent, but with an extremely low vacancy rate, finding the right home will be difficult.
